name: Outstanding Tenants
query: select t.name as "Tenant:Link/Tenant:180", t.tenant_name as "Tenant Name:Data:180", t.customer as "Customer:Link/Customer:180", coalesce(sum(si.outstanding_amount), 0) as "Outstanding Amount:Currency:160" from `tabTenant` t left join `tabSales Invoice` si on si.customer = t.customer and si.docstatus = 1 and si.outstanding_amount > 0 group by t.name, t.tenant_name, t.customer having coalesce(sum(si.outstanding_amount), 0) > 0 order by 4 desc
